capabilities: Create .url files via ribbon icon, command palette, or folder context menu
Open .url files in Obsidian's internal webview
Edit the URL stored in a .url file
Open the link in the default browser
Prepend https:// to URLs typed without a scheme
disambiguation: Not a general link opener; it only handles .url files, and the README points users who want all links in a webview to the Webview Core Plugin instead.
extras: README includes maintainer-facing release instructions (build, tag, GitHub release) rather than user troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store and open .url shortcut files as vault items viewable in the internal webview.

relations.evidence: If you simply want all links to open in a webview, use the Webview Core Plugin instead.

summary: Plugin that creates, edits, and opens .url files inside Obsidian's native webview, with an option to open them in the default browser instead.
